sections.heading: Examples
sections.text: Zur Anmeldung: Der Preis wird per Überweisung bezahlt. :: About registration: the price is paid by bank transfer. Die Überweisung gilt als verbindliche Anmeldung. :: The transfer counts as a binding registration.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: verbindlich means binding: once you have signed up, you have to pay.
